## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle Yuán-period text is the structural-outline (*kē* 科) for the Southern Recension of the *Mahāparinirvāṇa-sūtra* (*Dà bān niè pán jīng* 大般涅槃經 [KR6g0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0003), T0375), arranged by [師正](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%B8%AB%E6%AD%A3) Shīzhèng and re-edited by [可度](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%8F%AF%E5%BA%A6) Kědù.
